general.title: Volume Control
general.hint: Audio panel knobs and latches set app volumes

backend.label: Backend
backend.hint: Windows app volumes, or VoiceMeeter strips and buses.
backend.more: Switching applies live. Windows volumes are restored, VoiceMeeter targets reset to 0 dB.

disableProsimNative.label: Disable ProSim native audio control
disableProsimNative.hint: Turn off ProSim's own Windows volume control so the two never fight.

requirePower.label: Only while the audio panel is powered
requirePower.hint: On: knobs and latches apply only with the panel's bus powered, like the real aircraft. Off: they always apply, like the remote mixer.
requirePower.more: Power is AC/DC ESS plus the audio switching knob for the captain, audio switching for the first officer, DC1 for the observer. Switching this applies at once: the current knob values are sent again.

acp.label: ACP
acp.hint: Which audio control panel drives the app volumes.

debugDump.failed: Dump failed — see the app log

mappings.title: App Mappings
mappings.hint: A channel may drive several processes
mappings.latchTitle: Drive mute from the REC latch
mappings.note: Process name without .exe, for example vPilot.
mappings.moreBody: Latch off: mute is never written, so an app muted elsewhere stays muted. An app run as administrator needs ProsimCompanion run as administrator too; the Status section flags them. LOUDSPEAKER is the cockpit loudspeaker dial (captain and first officer only); its Latch tick mutes the app with the dial fully down.

blacklist.title: Device Blacklist
blacklist.hint: Matched on the start of the device name

voiceMeeter.hint: Strips and buses through VoiceMeeter's remote API

dllPath.label: VoicemeeterRemote64.dll path
dllPath.hint: Empty finds the installed VoiceMeeter by itself. Set only for an unusual install folder.

voiceMeeter.notReachable: VoiceMeeter not reachable — generic strip/bus numbers shown
voiceMeeter.latchTitle: Drive mute from the REC latch
voiceMeeter.noLatchTitle: No REC latch on this dial. Fully down always mutes the target.
voiceMeeter.oncePerPanel: A channel may appear once per panel. A strip or bus may belong to one panel only.
voiceMeeter.oncePerPanelMore: Conflicting saves fall back to the captain's panel until fixed; the Status section shows why. Knob travel maps to −60 dB … +12 dB; 0 dB sits near 83 %.
voiceMeeter.loudspeaker: LOUDSPEAKER is the cockpit loudspeaker dial, on the captain's and first officer's lists.
voiceMeeter.loudspeakerMore: Map it to the strip or bus that feeds your cockpit speakers. The dial has no REC latch: fully down mutes the target. Manual chapter 8 (Loudspeaker dial) shows the VoiceMeeter wiring that puts the headset sound on the speakers.

mixer.title: Remote Mixer
mixer.hint: Voicemeeter on another PC, through the VoicemeeterBridge agent

enable.label: Enable remote mixer
enable.hint: Connects to the agent and drives the mappings below. Off opens no connection.
enable.more: The local VoiceMeeter backend above drives the VoiceMeeter on this PC. This card drives a VoiceMeeter on another PC, for example the one running vPilot. Setup for both PCs: docs/integrations/voicemeeter-bridge.md.

host.label: Host
host.hint: Name or IP address of the PC running VoicemeeterBridge.

port.label: Port
port.hint: The agent's port. 5088 unless you changed it there.

token.label: Token
token.hint: From the agent's tray menu, Copy token. Stored encrypted, never logged.

mixer.testTitle: Open a connection with the values above, saved or not, and read the agent's welcome.
mixer.liveTitle: Live state of the saved connection

reconnectDelay.label: Reconnect delay
reconnectDelay.hint: First retry after a drop. Doubles up to the maximum.

writeTimeout.label: Write timeout
writeTimeout.hint: How long a write waits for the agent's answer.

gainMin.label: Gain, knob fully down
gainMin.hint: −60 dB is as good as silent.

gainMax.label: Gain, knob fully up
gainMax.hint: +12 dB like the local backend (0 dB near 83 % of the knob). Set 0 for a strip that must never go past unity.

state.connectedNoVoicemeeter: Connected — Voicemeeter not running on the mixer PC

panel.title: Status Panel
panel.hint: Which strips and buses the Status section shows, with mute buttons
panel.pickHint: Tick the strips and buses to show. Names come from the mixer PC's Voicemeeter.

strips.label: Strips
strips.hint: Strip numbers as Voicemeeter shows them (1 = first), comma separated. Example: 1, 2, 3

buses.label: Buses
buses.hint: Bus numbers (1 = A1), comma separated. Example: 1, 4

panel.pendingHint: Once the agent is connected the strips and buses appear here by name, as tick boxes.
panel.reloadTitle: Read the strip and bus names from the mixer PC again (after renaming one in Voicemeeter).
panel.summary: {0} strips / {1} buses on the mixer PC
panel.summaryOffline: Agent not connected — generic strip/bus numbers shown

mappings.title: Mappings
mappings.hint: An audio-panel channel drives one strip or bus on the mixer PC
mappings.empty: No mappings yet. Add one below.
mappings.latchTitle: Drive the target's Mute from the REC push-button
mappings.enabledTitle: Off keeps the row without using it
mappings.noLatchTitle: No REC push-button on this dial. Fully down always mutes the target.
mappings.liveTitle: Gain and mute last sent, and the agent's answer
mappings.note: The knob sets the strip or bus gain; Latch ticked, the REC push-button mutes it. Strip and bus names come from the mixer PC once the agent is connected.
mappings.moreBody: Knob travel maps to the gain range under the connection card's advanced fields (−60 dB … +12 dB by default, like the local VoiceMeeter backend; 0 dB sits near 83 %). Latch off: the mute is never written, so a strip muted on the mixer PC stays muted. LOUDSPEAKER is the cockpit dial: no push-button, fully down mutes the target. Writes go out at most 20 times a second per parameter, latest value wins. The knob value goes out whether the audio panel is powered or not. Two rows on one strip: the last one to move wins.

runInterval.label: Run interval
runInterval.hint: Main check. Takes effect after an app restart.

startupGrace.label: Process startup grace
startupGrace.hint: Wait after a mapped app starts before looking for its sound.

maxSearches.label: Max session searches
maxSearches.hint: Failed lookups before the devices are scanned again.

status.title: Volume Control
status.hint: ACP knobs / REC latches → app volumes
status.elevated: Elevated process(es) detected: {0}. Run ProsimCompanion as administrator to control these apps — until then those mappings stay inactive.

appMappings.title: App Mappings
appMappings.hint: Live session state per mapped process
appMappings.emptyLink: add them in the CoreAudio section

voiceMeeterTargets.title: VoiceMeeter Targets
voiceMeeterTargets.hint: Live strip/bus state per bound channel
voiceMeeterTargets.emptyLink: configure mappings in the VoiceMeeter section

remoteMixer.title: Remote Mixer
remoteMixer.hint: Voicemeeter on the mixer PC, through VoicemeeterBridge
remoteMixer.voicemeeterNotRunning: Voicemeeter not running on the mixer PC
remoteMixer.failedTitle: Writes the agent refused or that timed out since start
remoteMixer.emptyLink: pick them in the Remote Mixer section
remoteMixer.label: Label
